title: The Power of Smart Digital Advertising for Pet Groomers

facts.fact: In the case study, a mobile pet grooming business with locations across the country saw millions of impressions, hundreds of thousands of clicks and tens of thousands of conversions over the past six months (vendor-reported, no exact figures given).
facts.quote: Over the past six months, they’ve seen millions of impressions, hundreds of thousands of clicks and tens of thousands of conversions.

facts.fact: Compared with the previous 6-month period, the featured mobile pet groomer had a 134% increase in impressions (vendor-reported case study).
facts.quote: Compared to the previous 6-month period, this mobile pet groomer had a 134% increase in impressions

facts.fact: Compared with the previous 6-month period, the featured mobile pet groomer had a 696% increase in clicks (vendor-reported case study).
Compared with the previous 6-month period, the featured mobile pet groomer had a 682% increase in conversions (vendor-reported case study).
The featured pet groomer's advertising was placed on Facebook and Google, selected after identifying where its target audience spends time online.
facts.quote: This helped them choose the right channels to advertise on — Facebook and Google.

facts.fact: The featured pet groomer used lookalike audiences plus location- and interest-based targeting for its advertising.
facts.quote: By targeting lookalike audiences, as well as potential customers based on their location and interests

facts.fact: The case study's screenshots were taken on June 13, 2023 under account M37155.
The vendor states that results are based on past client performance, individual account performance may vary, and results are not guaranteed.
facts.quote: Results are based on past client performance. Individual account performance may vary. Results are not guaranteed.
